captions.detailed: A manual-focus prime lens assembly rendered in a matte black finish with a silver metal mount at the base. It features a wide, ribbed focus ring around the midsection, a smaller ribbed aperture ring near the mount, and a removable conical lens hood at the front. The focus ring and aperture ring both rotate continuously about the central axis, while the lens hood attaches and rotates on a short bayonet mount with small rectangular locking tabs.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a manual-focus prime lens with a matte black body and a silver metal mount. Include a continuously rotating ribbed focus ring, a smaller continuously rotating aperture ring near the base, and a removable lens hood that attaches via a short bayonet twist joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main lens body using a series of concentric cylinders and cones, and add a silver cylinder at the base for the lens mount. Model the focus and aperture rings by patterning rectangular ribs radially around cylinders. Create the lens hood as a hollowed-out stepped cone, adding two small rectangular tabs for the bayonet mechanism. Finally, define continuous joints for the focus and aperture rings, and a revolute joint with tight limits for the bayonet-mount lens hood.
